errors.evidence: The description reports calculated percentages for the pie slices (e.g., 11.5%, 27.6%, etc.). However, the chart does not provide percentages; it explicitly gives the raw number of responses for each category in the legend (10, 24, 25, 8, 20). Reporting calculated percentages is an interpretation that goes beyond describing the visual information directly presented in the figure.

errors.text_span: Категориите са подредени според броя на отговорите
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories are ordered by the number of responses. Neither the pie slices (which follow the order 10, 24, 25, 8, 20) nor the legend items are sorted by their corresponding values.

errors.text_span: като процентите са приблизително изчислени въз основа на данните
errors.evidence: This phrase is a meta-commentary on how the description was generated, rather than a description of the figure itself. It adds unnecessary text and detracts from an objective description of the visual content.
